text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up: we need pragmatic rollout safety items after the tenant outage. Quick list below, please ack owners.
sam: I'll take auto-rollback + simulation mode. Plan: prototype controller, suggest thresholds, PR by next Fri.
li: I'll own blast-radius gating (per-flag caps: users/hosts/percentage) and migration plan for existing flags.
ryan: Observability: dashboard tiles + alert rules. Propose signals: 5xx >0.5% over 3m, p95 >2x baseline over 5m, cross-tenant error spikes.
tess: I'll implement a synthetic smoke-run that gates beyond 5% ramp. Failures hold at 5% and require manual continue.
security-team: Kill-switch must be Vault-backed with RBAC and audit logs; recommend two-person approval for global emergency off.
marta: Proposed owners/dates: sam 2026-04-01, li 2026-03-30, ryan 2026-04-03, tess 2026-04-02, security-team 2026-03-31.
sam: API sketch (simulation): POST /rollouts/:id/auto_rollback {enabled:true, simulation:true, conditions:["500_rate>0.5%"], grace_period_s:180}
li: Blast-radius example: {max_users:1000, max_hosts:10, max_percentage:5}
ryan: I'll surface rollback suggestions in UI during simulation; automated actions after validation. Need a quick sync Thu 10:00 to lock timelines.
marta: Created umbrella tickets and linked to postmortem. Please react :thumbsup: to accept ownership.
ryan: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
security-team: acknowledged
deploy-bot: infra/rollout-controller deploy started
